observations.note: One mobile chamber platoon. Matching count and denominator in Hornberger Figure IV-154. Unit is an evaluable chamber test record. Repeat participation, the role mix in these surviving records, complete pressure and oxygen histories, and delayed clinical follow-up are unavailable. The broader program contains other units and periods.
observations.protocol: Luftwaffe Test No. 2, typically for fighter and long-distance reconnaissance crew. Printed schedule ascends to 10,000 m at an average 1,000 m/min, pauses five minutes, and reaches 12,000 m in another two to three minutes. Oxygen usually begins on the ground, by 4,000 m at latest. The planned peak hold is ten minutes with early termination for severe symptoms. Exam sheets record seated writing.
